welcome_sub: Find showers, soup kitchens, shelters, and assistance desks in Como in real time.
search_placeholder: Search by name, service, street or neighborhood...
no_results_sub: Try searching with different words or reset the category filters.
news_page_sub: Real-time alerts on schedule changes, emergency winter shelters, or notices from Como associations.
emergency_sub: Toll-free numbers active 24/7 for any health or safety emergency.
em_street_unit_desc: If you see someone in severe distress on the streets of Como at night, report it to volunteers.
choose_contact_method: Choose how to contact the service
tpl_desc_summer_closure: The service will be closed for the summer from {data_inizio} to {data_fine}.
tpl_desc_holiday_closure: The service will be closed for the holidays on {data}.
tpl_desc_address_change: The service is temporarily moving to {indirizzo} starting {data}.
tpl_desc_weather_closure: Service is temporarily closed due to adverse weather conditions.
tpl_desc_service_suspended: Service is suspended until further notice.
tpl_desc_service_updated: Information or schedules for this service have just been updated.
tpl_desc_posti_esauriti: Please be advised that all beds are full for tonight.
tpl_desc_emergenza_freddo: Extraordinary Winter Plan opening due to severe cold.
tpl_desc_guasto_tecnico: Service temporarily suspended due to technical issues.
tpl_desc_raccolta_urgente: We urgently need: {oggetto}. You can drop it off at our location.
tpl_desc_distribuzione_speciale: A special distribution of {oggetto} is scheduled for today.
tpl_desc_assenza_medico: Medical desk is suspended on {data} due to staff absence.
news_empty_sub: Updates from street outreach units and services will appear here.
push_active_sub: You will receive notifications on your device for emergencies and schedule changes.
push_inactive_sub: Enable notifications so you don't miss schedule changes and urgent alerts in Como.
push_blocked_sub: Your browser/device is blocking notifications. Enable them in browser site settings (Notifications → Allow) and tap the button below.
pwa_banner_sub_default: Quick access to services even offline
pwa_modal_installed_sub: The application is already installed and saved on this device.
pwa_modal_open_mobile: Look for the green Vicini di Strada icon on your Home screen or app drawer.
pwa_modal_open_pc: Look for the Vicini di Strada icon on your Desktop or Start menu.
pwa_modal_offline_note: Opening it from there runs the app full-screen and allows offline access.
pwa_modal_reinstall_mobile: Can't find it? Tap here to download again
pwa_modal_reinstall_pc: Want to reinstall it on your computer? Click here
pwa_modal_intro: Install the app to always have Como canteens, shelters, showers, and emergency contacts at hand, even offline.
pwa_modal_ios_step1: Tap the Share button at the bottom (square with upward arrow).
pwa_modal_ios_step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
pwa_modal_ios_step3: Tap "Add" in the top right corner.
pwa_modal_browser_title: How to install from your browser:
pwa_modal_browser_desc: Open the browser menu (three dots at top right) and select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
push_blocked_android_step1: Open your browser → tap the 3 dots (⋮) at top right → Settings → Site settings → Notifications.
push_blocked_android_step2: Allow notifications for this site, then return here and tap the button below.
push_blocked_ios_step1: Open iPhone Settings → Notifications → Vicini di Strada.
push_blocked_ios_step2: Enable Allow Notifications and return to this screen.
push_blocked_pc_step1: Click the site settings / lock icon on the left side of the browser address bar.
push_blocked_pc_step2: Set Notifications → Allow and click the button below.
push_ios_home_sub: On iPhone, Apple requires adding the app to your Home Screen first:
push_ios_home_step1: Tap Share at the bottom in Safari → Add to Home Screen.
push_ios_home_step2: Open the app from the new icon and tap Enable Notifications.
